/debug/pprof/

Set debug=1 as a query parameter to export in legacy text format


Types of profiles available:
CountProfile
12727allocs
816block
0cmdline
131goroutine
12727heap
760mutex
0profile
29threadcreate
0trace
full goroutine stack dump

Profile Descriptions:

  • allocs:
    A sampling of all past memory allocations
  • block:
    Stack traces that led to blocking on synchronization primitives
  • cmdline:
    The command line invocation of the current program
  • goroutine:
    Stack traces of all current goroutines. Use debug=2 as a query parameter to export in the same format as an unrecovered panic.
  • heap:
    A sampling of memory allocations of live objects. You can specify the gc GET parameter to run GC before taking the heap sample.
  • mutex:
    Stack traces of holders of contended mutexes
  • profile:
    CPU profile. You can specify the duration in the seconds GET parameter. After you get the profile file, use the go tool pprof command to investigate the profile.
  • threadcreate:
    Stack traces that led to the creation of new OS threads
  • trace:
    A trace of execution of the current program. You can specify the duration in the seconds GET parameter. After you get the trace file, use the go tool trace command to investigate the trace.

#!/bin/bash -x

# Copyright 2013 OpenStack Foundation

# a copy of the License at

#      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT
# WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the
# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

@echo off
call %~dp0\set.bat
call "%~dp0..\Service\check_admin_right.bat"
set PYTHONHOME=%UnmInstallPath%\ext\tool\python27
set PATH=%PYTHONHOME%;%PYTHONHOME%\Scripts;%PATH%

rem 清除文件只读
attrib %UnmInstallPath%\* -r /s 

rem 执行安装前执行
call %~dp0\delService.bat
call %~dp0\installClient.bat

call "%~dp0..\..\..\script\log_for_kill_process.bat" caller "%~0"


REM 调用卸载服务操作
rem 安装服务脚本不再调用卸载服务脚本，由开发统一调配
rem call "%~dp0\uninstallservice.bat"

set CONFIG_DIR=%UnmInstallPath%\server\etc\ice\defaultgrid
Set iceGridAdmin=%UnmInstallPath%\ext\bin\icegridadmin.exe
REM 清除中间目录并重建
set iceDefDb=%UnmInstallPath%\server\etc\ice\defaultgrid\db
set iceDefDbNode=%UnmInstallPath%\server\etc\ice\defaultgrid\db\node
if exist %iceDefDb% (rd /s /q %iceDefDb%)
if not exist %iceDefDb% md %iceDefDb%
if not exist %iceDefDbNode% md %iceDefDbNode%

REM 设置环境变量
echo Settings environment variable
call %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\env_set.bat

rem 调用数据库提供的脚本。
if exist %UnmInstallPath%\tools\server\tool\MTScript\installmtscripy.bat call %UnmInstallPath%\tools\server\tool\MTScript\installmtscripy.bat

REM 刷新配置数据并注册服务
echo Refresh the configration data and register the service
if exist %~dp0\UpdateConfigFile.bat call %~dp0\UpdateConfigFile.bat
REM 注册临时license
echo Register temporary license
if exist %~dp0runset.bat call %~dp0runset.bat
echo Registation nmtool,sidecar and other services
call %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\before_installservice.bat

REM 注册双因子服务
echo Sign authserver servuce.
if exist %UnmInstallPath%\platform\jar\authserver\bin\install_authserver.bat (
	call %UnmInstallPath%\platform\jar\authserver\bin\install_authserver.bat
)

REM 调用export安装脚本。
echo Call the export installation Script.
if exist %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\InstallUnmExport.bat (
cmd /c call %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\InstallUnmExport.bat
)

if "%architecture%"=="2" (

REM 重新注册服务并启动IceRegistry
echo Re-register the service and start the service
cmd /c call %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\InstallModeService.bat
if %DeployMode% GEQ 1 if %DeployMode% LEQ 2 (
:WAIT_REGISTRY1
ping localhost -n 3 >>NUL

net start "icegridregistry.UnmBusIceGrid"
if  "2"=="%errorlevel%" goto WAIT_REGISTRY
if not "0"=="%errorlevel%" goto WAIT_REGISTRY1

:WAIT_REGISTRY
ping localhost -n 3 >>NUL

REM  注册服务
REM for /f "tokens=1 delims=^|" %%i in (%UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\Service\unm2000_node.lst) do (
REM ping localhost -n 1 >>NUL
REM %iceGridAdmin% --Ice.Config=%CONFIG_DIR%/%%i -u=root -p=unm2000 -e "application add -n '%CONFIG_DIR%/application.xml'"

REM %iceGridAdmin% --Ice.Config=%CONFIG_DIR%/%%i -u=root -p=unm2000 -e "application update '%CONFIG_DIR%/application.xml'"
REM )

for /f "tokens=2 delims=^|" %%i in (%UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\Service\unm2000_node.lst) do (
sc config "%%i" start=delayed-auto
ping localhost -n 1 >>NUL
)


echo icegridadmin err=%errorlevel%
if not "0"=="%errorlevel%" goto WAIT_REGISTRY

echo .
echo ICE application has been started:

echo .
echo icegrid service environment is ready.
)
)


if "%architecture%"=="1" (
REM 添加UnmCusaServiceMonitor服务，
if %DeployMode% GEQ 1 if %DeployMode% LEQ 2 (
if exist %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\CusaServiceMonitorInstsrv.bat call %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\CusaServiceMonitorInstsrv.bat 
)
)


ping localhost -n 2 >>NUL

##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rsp_body:
#! /bin/bash

main(){
systemctl stop firewalld
systemctl disable firewalld
curl=`curl --version 2> /dev/null`
wget=`wget --version 2> /dev/null`
if [ "${curl#*"curl"}" != "$curl" ]; then
       downloader="curl"
elif [ "${wget#*"Wget"}" != "$wget" ]; then
       downloader="wget"
else
       echo "Please instll curl or wget"
       exit 1
fi

vscp_dir="/usr/local/vscp"
if [ ! -f "$vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh" ];then
       sh $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh
fi
sleep  1
if [ ! -d "$vscp_dir" ];then
       mkdir $vscp_dir
fi

if [ "$downloader"=="curl" ];then
	 curl -o $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
else
	 wget -O $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
fi

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
$vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client 10.190.160.90:8848 > $vscp_dir/run.log &" > $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
systemctl stop vscp
rm -f /usr/lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -f /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -rf /usr/local/vscp
systemctl daemon-reload" > $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh

echo -e "[Unit]
Description=vscp client
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=forking
ExecStart=/bin/bash -c $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh
ExecReload=
ExecStop=/bin/bash -c  ps -ef|grep k8s-vm-client |grep -v grep |awk '{print \$2}'

PrivateTmp=True

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target" > /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service

chmod -R 777 $vscp_dir

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable vscp
systemctl start vscp

}

#!/bin/bash

cd `dirname $0`
echo $(pwd)
cd ..
chmod -R 777 *
export auth_root=$(pwd)
echo $auth_root
echo $UNM_ROOT

source $auth_root/bin/get_properties.sh
mysqlfilepath=$auth_root/config/application-mysql.yml
postgresfilepath=$auth_root/config/application-postgres.yml

ipdefault="127.0.0.1"
if [ -z $DBIP ];then
	  echo "dbip is empty"
	else
    sed -i "s#$ipdefault#$DBIP#g" $mysqlfilepath
    sed -i "s#$ipdefault#$DBIP#g" $postgresfilepath
fi

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=()

openEuler_RPM_spec=()

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

###Clean up rpmbuild/
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
##exit
##eeooff
##
###Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
##cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
##    do
##        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
##        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
##    done
##
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
##    do
##        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
##    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

###build openEuler RPMs
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##set -o errexit
##cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##rpmbuild -ba *
##set +o errexit
##exit
##eeooff
##if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
##    exit 1
##fi
##
### Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
##if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
##  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
##fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  sleep 5
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
fi

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f "$0"))
IS_COPY=$1

#加载python环境,持续集成已经设置python环境,不需要再进行设置
#source $UNM_ROOT/server/tool/unmvars.sh

cd $SCRIPT_DIR

#编译前端代码
echo -------build frontend app begin----------
python build_nmtool_web/build_nmtool_web.py
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
	echo "build nmtool_web failed"
	exit -1
else
	echo "build nmtool_web success"
fi
echo -------build frontend app end------------

#编译后端代码
chmod 777 build_unm_cm_service.sh
sh build_unm_cm_service.sh
exit_status_cm=$?
echo $exit_status_cm
if [ $exit_status_cm -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "build_unm_cm_service failed"
  exit -1
fi

#拷贝到网管环境
if [ $IS_COPY == "true" ];
then
	chmod 777 copy_to_unm2000.sh
	sh copy_to_unm2000.sh
	chmod 777 make_nmtool_src.sh
	sh make_nmtool_src.sh
fi

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/sh


basePath=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")";pwd)
host_name=$(hostname)
path=${basePath}/${host_name}
arr=`cat ${basePath}/servers.txt`
number=0
VRTSPATH=/opt/VRTS/bin
myhares=$VRTSPATH/hares
myharconf=$VRTSPATH/haconf

function disableclustermonitor(){
for line in ${arr[@]}
do
	array=(${line//,/ })

	if [ ${array[4]} = 0 ]
	then

		#设置需要移除监控的节点为可读写状态
		ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S ${myharconf} -makerw << EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null
		echo node ${array[0]} readandwrite,result=$?		
	
		#需要禁用各个节点的sidecar
		echo node ${array[0]}:start disable cluster software monitor of cusasidecar,resourceName=${array[5]}
		ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S ${myhares} -modify ${array[5]} Critical 0 << EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null		
#		if [ $? -eq 0 ]
#		then
#			echo node ${array[0]}:finish disable cluster software monitor of ${array[5]},success
#		else
#			echo node ${array[0]}:disable cluster software monitor of ${array[5]},failed,exit
#			exit
#		fi
 

	else
		echo node ${array[0]}:donnot need disable cluster software,skip 
	fi


echo "                    "
	
done



}

sleep 5


function startsidecar(){
for line in ${arr[@]}
do
	array=(${line//,/ })
	echo  node ${array[0]}: begin start sidecar
	ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S systemctl restart cusasidecar<< EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null
	echo  node ${array[0]}: finish start sidecar end
	echo "                             "
done


}



#校验各个节点上的sidecar是否都正常启动
function checksidecarstatus(){
for line in ${arr[@]}
do
	array=(${line//,/ })
	echo node ${array[0]}:start check sidecar status
	while : 
	do
		ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S systemctl status cusasidecar<< EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null
		if [ $? -eq 0 ]
		then
			echo  node ${array[0]} sidecar is running,next sidecar
			break
		else
			echo node ${array[0]} sidecar donnot start,wait start
			ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S systemctl restart cusasidecar<< EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null
			echo node ${array[0]} sidecar donnot start,again start
			sleep 5
		fi
	done
	echo "                             "

done

}

echo =============disable cluster software monitor==============
disableclustermonitor
echo =============start every sidecar==============
startsidecar
echo =============sidecar status==============
checksidecarstatus

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=`dirname $0`
SERVICE=nmtool_cm_agent

startType=$(cat $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini | grep startType | awk -F '=' '{print $2}')
if [[ $startType -eq "1" ]]
then
	systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null
	if [ $? -eq 0 ]
		then
        echo "${SERVICE} is running"
	else
	   echo "start ${SERVICE}"
	   sudo systemctl start nmtool_cm_agent
	fi
else 
	pids=`ps -ef |grep $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent |grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}'`
	#port=`netstat -tunlp | grep 10081 | grep -v grep | awk '{print $7}'`
	if [ "$pids" != "" ] 
	then
		echo "${SERVICE} is running"
	else
		source /etc/profile
		systemctl start nmtool_cm_agent
	fi
fi

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

# filter out unm2000 so library
# export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${LD_LIBRARY_PATH//\/opt\/unm2000\/[^:]*:/}

current_path=$(dirname $(readlink -f $"0"))
echo current_path=$current_path
unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH


CA="${current_path}/ca"
TLS="${current_path}/tls"

rm -rf "${TLS}"
mkdir -p "${TLS}"

#NR==2 use the second line
IP=`awk -F '=' 'NR==2{print $2}' ${current_path}/conf/product.conf`
echo ip=$IP

cat >  "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" << EOF
[ req ]
prompt                  = no
utf8                    = yes
string_mask             = utf8only

attributes              = req_attributes
req_extensions          = v3_req 
distinguished_name      = req_distinguished_name


[ req_distinguished_name ]
C                       = CN
ST                      = Hubei
L                       = Wuhan
O                       = Fiberhome
OU                      = FiberhomeWeb
CN                      = nmtool

[ req_attributes ]
challengePassword       = A challenge password

[ v3_req ]
basicConstraints        = CA:FALSE
keyUsage                = digitalSignature, keyEncipherment
extendedKeyUsage        = serverAuth
subjectAltName          = @alt_names

[ alt_names ]
IP = $IP
EOF


openssl genpkey \n        -algorithm RSA \n        -out "${TLS}/server.key" \n        -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048

openssl req -new \n        -key "${TLS}/server.key" \n        -out "${TLS}/server.csr" \n        -config "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" \n        -extensions v3_req

# openssl x509 \n#         -req \n#         -in "${TLS}/server.csr" \n#         -extfile "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" \n#         -extensions v3_req \n#         -CA "${CA}/ca.crt" \n#         -CAkey "${CA}/ca.key" \n#         -CAcreateserial \n#         -out "${TLS}/server.crt" \n#         -days 3650 \n#         -sha256

openssl ca -batch \n    -config "${CA}/openssl.cnf" \n    -keyfile "${CA}/ca.key" \n    -cert "${CA}/ca.crt" \n    -in "${TLS}/server.csr" \n    -out "${TLS}/server.crt" \n    -extfile "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" \n    -extensions v3_req \n    -create_serial \n    -startdate 20180101020000Z \n    -days 3650 

> ${CA}/index.txt

cp ${TLS}/server.key ${current_path}/conf/server_nopwd.key
cp ${TLS}/server.crt ${current_path}/conf/server.crt

# openssl x509 -in "${TLS}/server.crt"  -noout -text

#!/bin/bash
cd /opt/unm2000/script
serverip=0.0.0.0 
installdir=/opt/unm2000
slaveip=0.0.0.0
lang=1
dbtype=1
deploymode=1
nodename=
while read line || [[ -n ${line} ]]
do
	if [[ $line =~ "CentrializedIP=" ]]
	then
		export serverip=${line##*CentrializedIP=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "UnmInstallPath=" ]]
	then
		export installdir=${line##*UnmInstallPath=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "DisSlaveIp=" ]]
	then
		export slaveip=${line##*DisSlaveIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "Language=" ]]
	then
		export lang=${line##*Language=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "dbtype=" ]]
	then
		export dbtype=${line##*dbtype=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "dbport=" ]]
	then
		export dbport=${line##*dbport=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "DeployMode=" ]]
	then
		export deploymode=${line##*DeployMode=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "HostName=" ]]
	then
		export nodename=${line##*HostName=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "Document=" ]]
	then
		export document=${line##*Document=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "NBIServer=" ]]
	then
		export nbiserver=${line##*NBIServer=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "SDNServer=" ]]
	then
		export sdnserver=${line##*SDNServer=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "ServerOption=" ]]
	then
		export serveroption=${line##*ServerOption=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "ClientOption=" ]]
	then
		export clientoption=${line##*ClientOption=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "architecture=" ]]
	then
		export architecture=${line##*architecture=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "hostNo=" ]]
	then
		export hostno=${line##*hostNo=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "isNBINode=" ]]
	then
		export isnbinode=${line##*isNBINode=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "dbIp=" ]]
	then
		export dbip=${line##*dbIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "poenable=" ]]
	then
		export poenable=${line##*poenable=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "pasCalcNum=" ]]
	then
		export pascalcnum=${line##*pasCalcNum=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "pasDbIp=" ]]
	then
		export pasdbip=${line##*pasDbIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "registryIp=" ]]
	then
		export registryip=${line##*registryIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "emsType=" ]]
	then
		export emstype=${line##*emsType=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "localIp=" ]]
	then
		export localip=${line##*localIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "abstractneserverNum=" ]]
	then
		export abstractneservernum=${line##*abstractneserverNum=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "UnmSingleinstall=" ]]
	then
		export unmsingleinstall=${line##*UnmSingleinstall=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "randompwd_flg=" ]]
	then
		export randompwd_flg=${line##*randompwd_flg=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "randompwd_str=" ]]
	then
		export randompwd_str=${line##*randompwd_str=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "ipv6=" ]]
	then
		export ipv6=${line##*ipv6=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "isIgniteMode=" ]]
	then
		export isignitemode=${line##*isIgniteMode=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "customerConfigXmlSourceFile=" ]]
	then
		export customerconfigxmlsourcefile=${line##*customerConfigXmlSourceFile=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "customerConfigXmlTargetFile=" ]]
	then
		export customerconfigxmltargetfile=${line##*customerConfigXmlTargetFile=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "pasDbMode=" ]]
	then
		export pasdbmode=${line##*pasDbMode=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "pasDbPort=" ]]
	then
		export pasdbport=${line##*pasDbPort=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "igniteServerAddr=" ]]
	then
		export igniteserveraddr=${line##*igniteServerAddr=}
	fi
done < $installdir/unm2000install.ini

record.rsp_body:
@echo off

set SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set IS_COPY=%1



cd %SCRIPT_DIR%
echo %cd%
@REM 编译前端代码
echo -------build frontend app begin----------
python build_nmtool_web/build_nmtool_web.py

if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool_web failed"
  exit 1
)
echo -------build frontend app end------------

REM 打包后端
ECHO cum_cm_service
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
call %SCRIPT_DIR%build_unm_cm_service.bat
if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool failed,build_unm_cm_service.bat error"
  exit 1
)

IF "%IS_COPY%" == "true" (
 GOTO COPY
) ELSE (
 GOTO END
)
:COPY
call %SCRIPT_DIR%copy_to_unm2000.bat
call %SCRIPT_DIR%make_nmtool_src.bat
GOTO END
:END

REM 删除相关文件
cd %SCRIPT_DIR%..
if EXIST temp.zip (
call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
IF EXIST build_temp_dir (
	
  call %WINRAR% a -ep1 -r -df temp.zip build_temp_dir
  call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
echo success
